versionImpact.rationale: Adopt the v4 sealed OCI provider and qualified preview callback while retaining the existing v1.0 installation, package, and data contracts.

surfaceImpacts.rationale: Buildchain v4 owns sealed OCI publication, protected version state, the Release Passport and settlement.
Retain both architectures, pinned package and base inputs, SBOM, provenance and execution smokes in one immutable OCI index.
Retain one-command Compose and preserved-volume upgrade/rollback; move preview through the public v4 callback after qualification.

summary: Buildchain v4 publishes the sealed dual-platform image and immutable Compose application; the preview moves only after exact public installation and persistence qualification.
